name: @w6w-apps/paypal
description: Create and manage PayPal orders, payments, invoices and payouts, plus triggers on captures, refunds, orders, invoices and payouts.

w6w.longDescription:
PayPal creates and manages orders, payments, invoices and payouts through PayPal's own REST API, working against either a live or sandbox app depending on the credentials connected. Orders can be created and captured, a completed capture can be looked up and refunded, and invoices can be created, listed, read and sent to a customer.

Payouts to one or many recipients can be created, checked and cancelled, accepting PayPal's own payout-item shape directly so a multi-recipient batch doesn't need to be flattened into a simplified form first. Capture and refund actions carry PayPal's own idempotency key so a retried step can't double-charge or double-refund a customer, and a retried payout batch is deduplicated the same way through its own batch id.

Authentication is app-level rather than tied to any individual buyer, using PayPal's client-credentials grant — the same shape suited to scheduled and unattended workflow runs, with no browser sign-in step involved.

Six triggers start a workflow when something happens in PayPal: a payment captured or refunded, a checkout order approved, an invoice paid, a payout item paid out, or any event types you list. Subscribing registers a webhook with PayPal and unsubscribing removes it; every delivery is verified with PayPal itself before a run starts.
